reviewNotes: Reviewed all 20 cards and 127 distinct speech keys against data/pages75-about-eggs.json vocabulary and furigana. Verified egg anatomy and cooking readings including 濃厚卵白 のうこうらんぱく, 卵黄膜 らんおうまく, 浮力 ふりょく, 凝固 ぎょうこ, 固ゆで かたゆで, 目玉焼き めだまやき, 卵焼き たまごやき, 茶碗蒸し ちゃわんむし and 温泉卵 おんせんたまご. Removed duplicated exported 放し飼い before はなしがい; corrected contextual 何を分けますか from なん to なに. Reviewed topic は→わ, directional へ→え and object を→お in context; preserved lexical はんだん, はじく, はし, はっこう, はたらき, はんじゅく, はば, はいり and へんか/へんしょく. Converted katakana to hiragana retaining long-vowel marks. Questions, full explanations and sentence answers use 1.0; standalone vocabulary, paired vocabulary and very short grammar fragments use 0.85. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
